items.title: 10.4 Magnetic field mein charged zarre ki harkat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.4 with Fig. 10.10 and Example 10.3 (PDF 234-236).

blocks.text: Yaksan magnetic field mein amudi rakhe current wale conductor par force F lagti hai. Chunke current electric charges ka bahao hai, sawal uthta hai: kya magnetic field se guzarne wale alag alag charges par bhi force lagti hai? Jawab haan hai; tajrubat dikhate hain ke charged zarra magnetic field ke aar paar chale to us par force lagti hai. Yeh force hum current wale conductor ke magnetic field mein rawayye se nikal sakte hain.

Lambai L ka conductor lein jis se waqt t mein N charged zarre, har ek charge q wala, guzarte hain. In ki harkat current I = Q/t = Nq/t banati hai, jahan Q waqt t mein behne wala kul charge hai. Agar zarron ki velocity v ho to conductor ke saath un ki velocity v = v L(hat) hai, jahan L(hat) current ki simt mein unit vector hai. Force ki alamat is par munhasir hai ke q musbat hai ya manfi; L(hat) current ki simt mein hai, jo musbat charges ki harkat ki simt hai. Chunke zarre lambai L ka conductor paar karne mein waqt t lete hain, t = L/v, to I = Nq/t = Nqv/L ... (10.8).

Agar yeh conductor yaksan magnetic field B mein rakha jaye to us par force F = I L x B ... (10.9) lagti hai. Chunke L = L L(hat) ... (10.10), I aur L rakhne par F = (Nqv/L)(L L(hat) x B), ya F = Nqv L(hat) x B ... (10.11). Chunke velocity v conductor ke saath hai, F = Nq v x B ... (10.12). Lihaza ek zarre par force F = q v x B ... (10.13) hai.

blocks.title: Chalte charge par magnetic force
blocks.text: F = q v x B (10.13). Agar B aur v ka zawiya theta ho to miqdar F = qvB sin theta ... (10.14). Force zyada se zyada hai jab B, v ke amudi ho (theta = 90 degrees) aur sifar jab B, v ke saath ho (theta = 0). Is ki simt Fleming ke left-hand rule ya right-hand rule se milti hai (Fig. 10.3, print mein Fig. 10.8 ka hawala).

items: Musbat charged zarra field mein (B kaghaz ke andar) dotted lakeer ke saath dakhil ho kar oopar ki taraf force mehsoos karta hai aur kham-daar raste par mur jata hai (Fig. 10.10a).
Manfi charged zarra us par neeche ki taraf lagne wali force se neeche murta hai (Fig. 10.10b).

blocks.alt: Oopar baen: kaghaz ke andar field mein musbat zarra oopar murta, manfi zarra neeche murta, aur electron daire mein ghoomta jis par force markaz ki taraf hai. Oopar daen: velocity selector, jis mein musbat zarra charged plates ke darmiyan seedha guzarta hai jahan oopar ki magnetic force Bqv neeche ki electric force qE ko balance karti hai. Neeche: formulae aur Examples 10.3 se 10.5.
blocks.caption: Magnetic field mein charged zarre aur velocity selector (Figures 10.10 se 10.12 aur topics 10.4 aur 10.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Magnetic field ke aar paar chalta charge apni velocity aur field dono ke amudi force mehsoos karta hai, to musbat aur manfi charges ulti simton mein murte hain. Chunke force hamesha velocity ke amudi hai, yeh sirf harkat ki simt badalti hai, speed nahi, aur yaksan field mein charge daire mein ghoomta hai jis ka radius momentum taqseem charge zarb field hai. Velocity selector mein ek doosre ke amudi electric field aur magnetic field chalte charge ko ulti simton mein dhakelti hain; sirf woh charge jis ki speed electric field taqseem magnetic field ke barabar ho koi khalis force nahi mehsoos karta aur seedha guzarta hai.

blocks.title: Example 10.3
blocks.text: Ek electron (print mein 'election') 10^4 m s^-1 ki speed se yaksan magnetic field mein amudi dakhil hota hai. Field ke andar woh kis raste par chalega? (B = 2.5 Wb m^-2, m = 9.11 x 10^-31 kg, e = 1.6 x 10^-19 C.) Hal: F = qvB sin theta; chunke v, B ke amudi hai, theta = 90 degrees aur q = e, to F = evB. Chunke F, v ke amudi hai, yeh centripetal force banti hai jo electron ko radius r ke daire mein rakhti hai: evB = mv^2/r, to r = mv/(eB) = (9.11 x 10^-31 kg x 10^4 m s^-1)/(1.6 x 10^-19 C x 2.5 Wb m^-2) = 2.3 x 10^-8 m. Rasta 2.3 x 10^-8 m radius ka daira hai.

Electric field lines ki tarah magnetic field lines bhi kabhi ek doosre ko nahi kaatti, balke ek doosre se door dhakelti hain (Do You Know). Purane television screen, computer monitor ya oscilloscope ke qareeb bar magnet lane se tasveer bigar jati hai, kyunke magnetic force beam ke chalte electrons ko mor deti hai (Point to ponder).

blocks.prompt: Yaksan magnetic field mein charged zarre ke raste ka radius kis ke seedhe tanasub mein hai (MCQ 10.2)? Kya yaksan magnetic field chalte charged zarre ki kinetic energy badalti hai (constructed response 10.5)? Electron aur proton ek hi velocity se field ke amudi phenke jayein; kaun zyada murta hai (short question 10.7)?
blocks.explanation: r = mv/(qB), to r momentum mv ke tanasub mein hai, option (b). Nahi: magnetic force hamesha velocity ke amudi hai, to koi kaam nahi karti; harkat ki simt badalti hai magar speed ya kinetic energy nahi. Electron: ek hi charge aur speed magar kahin kam mass ke saath us ka radius r = mv/(eB) bohat chhota hai, to us ka rasta zyada tezi se murta hai.

blocks.prompt: Proton 0.300 T ki field mein 45 degrees par 10^7 m s^-1 se dakhil hota hai; us ke gol raste ka radius nikalein (numerical 10.8). 15 kV se tez kiye electrons 0.35 T field se guzarte hain; ek electron par zyada se zyada force nikalein (numerical 10.2).
blocks.explanation: Sirf field ke aar paar velocity ka juz, v sin 45 = 7.07 x 10^6 m s^-1, gol harkat banata hai: r = m v sin 45/(eB) = 1.67 x 10^-27 x 7.07 x 10^6/(1.6 x 10^-19 x 0.300) = 0.246 m. Electron ki speed v = sqrt(2eV/m) = sqrt(2 x 1.6 x 10^-19 x 15 000/9.11 x 10^-31) = 7.26 x 10^7 m s^-1, aur zyada se zyada force (theta = 90 degrees) evB = 1.6 x 10^-19 x 7.26 x 10^7 x 0.35 = 4.1 x 10^-12 N.

items: Lambai L ko waqt t = L/v mein paar karte N charges q: I = Nqv/L (10.8); F = I L x B (10.9) se F = Nq v x B (10.12) aur ek charge ke liye F = q v x B (10.13), F = qvB sin theta (10.14): field ke aar paar zyada se zyada, saath sifar.
Musbat aur manfi charges ulti simton mein murte hain (Fig. 10.10). Force v ke amudi: gol rasta r = mv/(qB), speed nahi badalti. Example 10.3: r = 2.3 x 10^-8 m.
